# Gcore Account settings

> Configure Gcore Customer Portal account settings, including profile, billing, users, API tokens, audit log, and notifications.

- [Account settings](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings.md): Configure Gcore Customer Portal account settings, including profile, billing, users, API tokens, audit log, and notifications.

## My profile
- [My profile settings](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/overview.md): Configure username, email, language, two-factor authentication, and password, and review login history on the My profile page.
- [Set up two-factor authentication](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/two-factor-authentication.md): Enable or disable two-factor authentication on My profile, including backup codes and an account-wide requirement.
- [Change or reset a password](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/change-password.md): Change or reset account password in Gcore Customer Portal via Profile settings, or reset a forgotten password via email at auth.gcore.com.
- [Missing password reset email](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/my-profile/password-reset-email.md): Troubleshoot missing password reset emails from support@gcore.com by looking in spam or resending the reset link at auth.gcore.com login forgot-password.

## Account
- [Account overview](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/overview.md): Configure account identification, billing address, tax settings, payment methods, and company account conversion in Gcore Customer Portal.
- [Create an account for an individual or legal entity](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/create-account.md): Create a Gcore account with email, Google, or GitHub, or contact sales to set up a legal entity contract before accessing the Customer Portal.
- [Create an additional account and switch between accounts](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/additional-accounts.md): View the active Gcore account in the profile menu and request an additional account through Gcore Support.
- [Disable or resume services](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/services.md): Check the status of Gcore services on the Customer Portal dashboard. Disabling and resuming a service is handled through Gcore Support.
- [Account deletion](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/account/account-deletion.md): Delete a Gcore account from General information in the Customer Portal. The request can be canceled within 10 days, and services stop immediately.

## Billing
- [Billing overview](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/overview.md): Review Gcore consumption billing, including the monthly collection day and the Cloud Pay-As-You-Go threshold of 4 EUR or USD.
- [Expenses](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/expenses.md): View Cloud project costs on Cost Report and reservation costs on Reservation Cost Report in Cloud Management.
- [Payments and payment methods](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/payments.md): Manage payment history, primary and backup payment methods, renewal retry, and manual or automatic balance top-ups.
- [Bonuses and discounts](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/bonuses-and-discounts.md): View bonus credit status, expiration, and discount details on the Bonuses and discounts page, and apply promo codes to receive bonus credits.
- [Trial conditions](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/trial-conditions.md): View free trial durations and limits for CDN, Video Streaming, WAAP, and Managed DNS Pro, and activate a trial from the Customer Portal.
- [VAT rates in different countries for an individual and legal entity](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/vat-rates.md): Determine the current VAT rate for individuals and organizations by country and VAT number status, and view the standard rate for each EU member state.
- [Tax location](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/tax-location.md): Determine how billing address and account details set the tax location and VAT rate, view the current rate, and update a VAT number.
- [Data deletion](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/billing/data-deletion.md): Determine how long Gcore products retain data after suspension before deleting it, by product and feature.

## Users
- [About users](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/users/about-users.md): Manage user roles and permissions in Gcore Customer Portal - Administrators, Engineers, and Purge Prefetch roles with rights to manage CDN, Video Streaming, Managed DNS, Object Storage, and WAAP services; assign roles, invite users, create API tokens, and enable 2-Factor authentication.
- [Manage users](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/users/manage-users.md): Invite, list, update, and delete account users in Gcore via Customer Portal or via REST API using the IAM API.
- [API tokens](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/api-tokens.md): Create, use, and delete API tokens with role-based access and configurable expiration for automated API requests.
- [Manage notification settings](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/notifications.md): Configure important, general, and product-specific email notifications for CDN, Cloud, Streaming, Colocation, and Object Storage in the Gcore Customer Portal.

## Support and resources
- [Technical support](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/how-quickly-our-support-team-will-respond-to-you.md): Determine technical support response times by support plan and request priority, and submit support requests through the headset icon in the Customer Portal.
- [Be aware of the service status, scheduled and emergency maintenance](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/be-aware-of-the-service-status-scheduled-and-emergency-maintenance.md): Subscribe to Gcore Status Page by email, Slack, or webhook for incident and maintenance notifications, and manage or cancel subscriptions by component.
- [Roadmap: submit feedback and track feature development](https://docs.gcore.com/account-settings/roadmap-provide-feedback-suggest-new-features-follow-development.md): Submit feature requests, vote on posts, and track development status for Gcore products through Gcore Roadmap.
